subject: prd/workbench-ui
statement: The reading room shall present a per-feature progress view derived solely from the committed corpus and git history, naming each feature's furthest pipeline artifact and its pending human gates, with each cell linking to its artifact.
rationale: "what stage is X at" is today a multi-directory investigation
fit_criterion: fixture corpus with features at distinct stages: each row names the expected stage and gates; adding an artifact to a fixture feature advances its row; the view is identical with networking disabled
